content:
**Super Mutant Behemoths** are creatures found in Appalachia.

Behemoths are powerful Super Mutants that have grown to an enormous size. Behemoths are armed with a fire hydrant still mounted to a massive water pipe. They also can throw heavy boulders from the shopping cart on their back. Huntersville Super Mutant Behemoths are susceptible to the Scorched Plague.

Super Mutant Behemoths may be accompanied by Super Mutants. They will become Scorched when fighting Scorchbeasts.

Scorched Super Mutant Behemoths are marked as unused content, but are susceptible to being Scorched by Scorchbeasts.
